svg.title: Encryption and decryption: plaintext, ciphertext and recovery
svg.desc: The ciphertext illustrates a representation, not an actual encryption result. The bank password is fictional teaching data. Real encryption also requires a suitable mode and key management.

g.font-family: Arial, Noto Sans CJK TC, sans-serif
g.text: Encryption and decryption: plaintext, ciphertext and recovery
Illustrative bytes, not an actual encryption result
The ciphertext illustrates a representation, not an actual
encryption result. The bank password is fictional teaching data.
Real encryption also requires a suitable mode and key management.
